upcoming.title: Annual Sportsmen Banquet
upcoming.description: Our flagship annual celebration! The Sportsmen Banquet is our biggest community event of the year, featuring a full dinner, social gathering, and a massive raffle with dozens of premium firearms, sporting gear, and door prizes.
upcoming.extraNote: Tickets sell out early every year—contact a board member for ticket availability!

upcoming.title: Youth Deer Hunt Buck Pole
upcoming.description: Supporting Michigan's next generation of hunters! We sponsor youth hunters during Michigan's early youth deer season, encouraging safe hunting habits and conservation traditions.

upcoming.title: Annual Buck Pole
upcoming.description: Bring your firearm deer season harvest to the American Legion in Standish! Join fellow hunters to hang your buck, compare antlers, win contest prizes, and celebrate Opening Day traditions.
